name: Winpro Industries Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1992, Winpro Industries 
Ltd is in the business of providing VOIP 
Services, and sale of trade goods[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) WIL is an integrated media and entertainment enterprise primarily engaged in broadcasting and media operations.
b) It also functions as a technology company offering next-generation digital services through a diversified product portfolio.
c) Core offerings include high-definition 
video streaming, audio streaming, VoIP, 
digital education, and remittance services
d) It integrates both hardware and software capabilities to transform network perceptions 
of content delivery and monetization.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.67 times its book value
cons: Company has a low return on equity of -0.31% over last 3 years.
